**Hiring Team**  
Insignia Financial  
Sydney NSW, Australia  

**Subject: Application for Lead Test Engineer (Data Engineering)**

Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Lead Test Engineer role within Data Engineering at Insignia Financial. With over 19 years of experience establishing test automation frameworks, steering quality engineering strategy, and leading QA teams through complex platform transformations, I am eager to help ensure that Insignia Financial’s data platforms and pipelines remain reliable, accurate, and production-ready.

Throughout my career, I have focused on driving quality across critical enterprise systems and distributed architectures. As QA Lead at Avant Mutual, I led a testing team through a large-scale migration to a cloud-native environment, establishing rigorous defect triage processes, leading cross-functional release management, and enforcing data integrity validation across the application lifecycle. Most recently at Wpay (Woolworths Group), I designed end-to-end automated testing architectures, embedded automated regression and validation suites into CI/CD pipelines, and developed custom automation tools that significantly reduced code review overhead and expanded test coverage.

My technical foundation aligns directly with the core requirements of your data ecosystem. I bring hands-on expertise in Python, SQL, and UNIX scripting, along with a deep understanding of CI/CD integration using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions. Additionally, holding a Google Cloud Generative AI certification and having extensive Agile/Jira experience, I am adept at collaborating closely with engineering and data teams to diagnose live issues, validate consistency across workflows, and champion continuous improvement in automated testing.

I welcome the opportunity to bring my quality leadership, automation background, and data validation experience to Insignia Financial. Thank you for your time and consideration, and I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills can support your data engineering initiatives in an interview.

Sincerely,

**Anoop Sinkaran**
